web.stack: Vue 3.5, vue-router 4, pinia 3, vite 6, vitest 3, happy-dom, @vue/test-utils, vue-tsc

dirs.components: subfolders album/, forms/, profile/, crate/ plus top-level LibraryToolbar.vue
dirs.views: CrateView, CratesView, LibraryView, AlbumView, AlbumEditorView, LoginView, SignupView, ProfileView, EditProfileView, NotFoundView

web.router: exports `router` (createWebHistory); lazy views for most routes; meta.requiresAuth augmented via declare module; guard uses session store

tests.framework: vitest run, environment happy-dom (configured in apps/web/vite.config.ts test block)
tests.appVueMount: App.test.ts: createPinia()+setActivePinia, createRouter with createMemoryHistory and Blank stub routes, await router.push('/') and isReady, mount(App, {global:{plugins:[pinia, router]}}), flushPromises; fetch stubbed with vi.stubGlobal
tests.routerTest: router.test.ts: imports real `router`, setActivePinia(createPinia()) per test, vi.mock('./api/auth.ts'), asserts router.currentRoute after router.push
